protocol.clocks: CPU/HTTP/model wall time separated from controlled source publication time
protocol.scorer: Exact structured tuples from an evaluator-generated corpus; no model judges or evaluator labels in candidate input
protocol.independence: Internal synthetic transfer test, not independently annotated real disaster data
protocol.model: Configured OpenRouter model, never assumed Gemini

deduplication: Reposts were persisted and grouped by public original references; the model received original requests plus independent historical/hostile sources. No private truth labels selected a request's factual content.
limitations: Synthetic internally authored cases, not independently annotated field accuracy
Only exact structured request recall/precision was scored. No claim of lives saved or human comprehension.
Acknowledgement and stored reposts do not count as new independent tasks.
Finite completed batches measure semantic processing, not real-time arrival/review stability at 10k/hour.
